description: Shute Harbour tide gauge—archived interval recordings is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Archived water level readings recorded at Shute Harbour using an automatic tide gauge. Please note: 2018 data file contain observations till 17 March 2018 as the gauge was removed. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are maritime, msq, shute harbour, standard port, tide. It offers 8 resource(s) in txt. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
